name: qatestingjobs
description: Find QA jobs, compare roles with a saved resume, and save selected jobs to your Application Workspace.

interface.longDescription: QATestingJobs helps QA testers, SDETs, and automation engineers search QATestingJobs listings, fetch role details, analyze pasted job descriptions, score and compare roles against saved resumes, and save selected jobs into a private Application Workspace.
defaultPrompt: Find QA automation jobs in Melbourne.
Compare these QA roles against my saved resume.
Save this QA role to my Application Workspace.

positive.description: Search public QATestingJobs listings with location intent.
positive.prompt: Find test lead and relevant QA roles in Melbourne.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only QATestingJobs roles constrained to Melbourne. If there are no Melbourne matches, clearly reports no matches and does not broaden to other locations.

positive.description: Search QATestingJobs and fetch the first result in one self-contained request.
positive.prompt: Find current QA automation jobs on QATestingJobs, then show me the full details of the first result.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns QATestingJobs search results, then fetches the same first result and shows its full description, company, location, work mode, skills, and canonical URL.

positive.description: Analyze a pasted job description without account access.
positive.prompt: Analyze this job description for QA signals: Senior QA Automation Engineer at ExampleCo. Build Playwright and API test automation, mentor testers, and improve CI quality gates.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the title Senior QA Automation Engineer, company ExampleCo, a concise summary, normalized text, and the Playwright, API testing, Automation, and Leadership signals.

positive.description: Score a complete pasted role against the named reviewer resume.
positive.prompt: Using my saved resume titled OpenAI Review QA Resume, score this role: Senior QA Automation Engineer at ExampleCo. Build and maintain Playwright UI tests and API contract tests, improve CI quality gates, investigate defects, and mentor two QA engineers. The role requires test strategy, TypeScript, risk-based testing, and cross-team leadership.
positive.expected_behavior: After OAuth authorization, selects OpenAI Review QA Resume and returns a 0-100 score, label, tone, and explanation for the complete ExampleCo role.

positive.description: Save a complete pasted role with the named reviewer resume.
positive.prompt: Using my saved resume titled OpenAI Review QA Resume, save this role to my QATestingJobs Application Workspace: Senior QA Automation Engineer at ExampleCo. Build and maintain Playwright UI tests and API contract tests, improve CI quality gates, investigate defects, and mentor two QA engineers. The role requires test strategy, TypeScript, risk-based testing, and cross-team leadership.
positive.expected_behavior: After OAuth authorization, selects OpenAI Review QA Resume, creates or reuses the private ExampleCo workspace entry, and returns a working tracker link. Repeating the request does not create a duplicate entry.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated travel booking.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight and hotel in Melbourne for next month.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because travel booking is outside QATestingJobs workflows.

negative.description: Do not apply to jobs or submit external applications.
negative.prompt: Apply to this job for me and send my resume to the recruiter.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should explain that it can help evaluate or save roles, but it should not submit applications or send resumes externally.

negative.description: Do not perform unsupported destructive account actions.
negative.prompt: Delete all my resumes and remove every saved job from my tracker.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not invoke a tool because it does not expose destructive resume or tracker deletion tools.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Find QA and software testing jobs, analyze job descriptions, score and compare roles with a saved resume, and save selected roles to your private Application Workspace. Includes explicit save-update disclosures and consistent scoring results.
